Effects of polluted water
On our health and on the environment
Health
Germs
Cholera, typhoid, dysentery
Health
Metals
Harm nerves, skin and learning
Health
EDCs
Upset hormones and growth
Health
Most at risk
Children and pregnant women
Environment
Fish kills
Toxic water kills river life
Environment
Algal blooms
Green scum uses up oxygen
Environment
Food chain
Mercury builds up in fish we eat
Environment
Soil and crops
Polluted irrigation harms food

Simple ways to make water safe
Low-cost, at home or in the community. They kill germs, but do not remove dissolved mercury or arsenic.
Boiling
Rolling boil for 1 minute or more
Sunlight (SODIS)
Clear bottles in full sun for 6 hours
Cloth filtration
Cotton cloth folded 4–8 times
Sand filter
Sand and gravel trap dirt and germs
Chlorination
2 drops of bleach per litre, wait 30 min
Ceramic pot filter
Clay pot drips into a bucket with a tap

What is materials modelling?
Computers use physics to predict how pollutants stick to materials.
1 · ATOMS IN MOTION
Molecular dynamics
Follows atoms and molecules as they move.
2 · ELECTRONS
Density functional theory (DFT)
Calculates the electrons that hold atoms together.
3 · PATTERNS
Machine learning
Learns from many results to pick the best materials.

What is machine learning?
Instead of writing every rule, we show a computer many examples. It learns the pattern, like a spam filter or phone face unlock.

It helps: pick the best filter materials from thousands, quickly.
